reference.pathophysiology: Cortical hypersynchrony discharges produce stereotyped tonic-clonic, absence, myoclonic and focal patterns; failure of termination past minutes becomes status risking neuronal injury, and mimics syncope and PNES mislead without witness and EEG.
additionalDifferentials: Epilepsy versus syncope versus PNES by injury EEG and prodrome
Absence versus focal by stare and deja vu
Status versus serial by regain and clock
